service.description: Receive a customer return shipment's lines: for each return item the quantity that arrived, accepted and rejected (quarantined) alike, received as stock (AssetReceipt) on the item's shipment source, added to ReturnItem.receivedQuantity. It never changes returnQuantity and processes no response, so a second box, or units rejected at the dock, can still be received and credited against the authorization by settle#Return. An item reaches ReturnReceived (ReturnManResp for a manual response) when its received quantity equals the authorized quantity, the return when every item is handled, and the shipment ShipDelivered when every source is handled. Refuses more than was authorized (RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_RETURN), an item not on the shipment, a closed item, a shipment that is not a customer return, and an organization that does not settle returns separately (RETURN_SETTLEMENT_OFF: Mantle receives its returns when the shipment is delivered). Needs STOCK_RECEIVE in the receiving organization.

parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: Defaults to the shipment's destination facility.

parameter.name: itemList
parameter.description: Maps of returnId, returnItemSeqId, quantityAccepted, quantityRejected, rejectionReasonEnumId and, for the stock, statusId (default AstOnHold) and lotNumber.

parameter.name: receivedItems
parameter.description: Each item's returnId, returnItemSeqId, receivedQuantity, statusId and assetReceiptIds.

service.description: Move an asset, or part of it, to a location or a container of its own facility, through mantle.product.AssetServices.move#Asset: a part becomes its own asset there, the whole asset moves, and the reservations it carries move with it as Mantle moves them. A retry with the same operation key and request answers the first move (alreadyApplied); a different request under the key is OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT. Refuses without STOCK_MOVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); an asset outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), equipment (NOT_STOCK), nothing on hand (NO_STOCK), a quantity above on hand (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ON_HAND); another facility (OTHER_FACILITY: a transfer); a closed or missing location (LOCATION_CLOSED, LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE); the place it is already (SAME_LOCATION); a container holding another owner's stock (CONTAINER_OWNER); a quarantined asset to a location whose type would release it, or any status change with no status flow transition (HELD_STOCK, F8). Reservations carried onto stock that is not available are checked again, so the order is re-reserved on available stock (F38). Expired and near-expiry stock moves with a warning naming its date. workEffortId is the production run a staging move is for, kept in the answer.

parameter.description: The client's operation id (a scan id or a form's operation id), at most 200 characters; scoped by user and operation type.

parameter.description: Empty moves the whole asset.

parameter.description: A container of the facility: the asset moves into it, at its location.

parameter.description: Given only to refuse another facility.

parameter.description: resultCode MOVED, assetId, toAssetId, productId, quantity, facilityId, fromLocationSeqId, toLocationSeqId, toContainerId, fromStatusId, statusId, reservationsChecked, warnings (code, expiryDate, message), reason, workEffortId, and the operation fields.

Each in its own transaction: one that fails is named and the others go on. Requires STOCK_POLICY_MANAGE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a facility of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

service.description: Unpack or repack stock (design-warehouse Repack): the source asset's quantity is issued (issue#AssetToWorkEffort) to a new organization-owned WepAssembling WorkEffort, which posts it to WIP, and the target product is received (receive#Asset) from it with the source's lot, expiry and owner and the acquireCost of the issued cost divided by the target quantity, which relieves WIP: the two postings net to zero through AssetIssuanceGlPost and AssetReceiptGlPost. The receipt links its source issuance (AssetReceipt.sourceAssetIssuanceId) and keeps the entered source quantity and the conversion factor. Both movements post or neither does. The conversion is Products' packaging (resolve#ScannedProduct): unpack a pack into its contents, or repack contents into whole packs. A retry with the same operation key answers the first repack. When the unit cost at the four decimals acquireCost keeps leaves a remainder, the last unit is received apart at the remainder's cost, so the receipts carry the issued value exactly. Refuses without STOCK_MOVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); as move#Stock: the user's facilities, the stock and quantity, a closed or missing location, a status change with no flow (HELD_STOCK); stock that is not available or on hold (HELD_STOCK); stock with no owner (OWNER_REQUIRED); stock that is not free to issue (RESERVED_STOCK); no packaging between the products (PACK_UNDEFINED); not whole packs (QUANTITY_NOT_WHOLE_PACKS); a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED).

parameter.description: Empty unpacks into the pack's contents.

parameter.name: toLocationSeqId
parameter.description: Where the target is received; the source's location when empty.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode REPACKED, direction, assetId, sourceProductId, quantity, targetProductId, targetQuantity, factor, toAssetId, receipts (assetId, assetReceiptId, quantity: one, or two when the last unit carries the remainder), lotId, facilityId, locationSeqId, statusId, workEffortId, assetIssuanceId, assetReceiptId, reason, warnings, and the operation fields.

service.description: Receive one line of a purchase receipt through mantle.shipment.ShipmentServices.receive#ShipmentProduct, atomically: the quantity accepted and rejected in the entered unit (the order line's unit by default; a pack of the product, resolved through mantle.product.ProductServices.resolve#ScannedProduct, counts its contents), converted to the product's stock unit and kept as entered on each receipt (enteredQuantity, enteredQuantityUomId, appliedConversionFactor); a lot, its expiry (the tracking policy's shelf life when none is given) and, for serialized stock, one unique serial per accepted unit; to the operation policy's receipt step at posting (resolve#WarehousePolicy): 1 the product's default location or the receiver's, 2 the receiving location, 3 a quarantine location; a rejected quantity becomes no stock. A retry with the same operation key answers the first receipt. Requires STOCK_RECEIVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a receipt outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one that is not a purchase receipt (RECEIPT_TYPE) or no longer open (RECEIPT_CLOSED), a product not on it (PRODUCT_NOT_ON_RECEIPT), no quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), a rejection without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED), more than the policy's over-receipt tolerance allows, zero by default (OVER_RECEIPT), a serial count that does not match the accepted units (SERIAL_COUNT_MISMATCH), a serial given twice or already in stock (SERIAL_DUPLICATE), a lot-tracked product without a lot (LOT_REQUIRED), a unit with no conversion (UNIT_CONVERSION), and a closed or missing destination (LOCATION_CLOSED, LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: productId
parameter.description: The product, or a pack of it.

parameter.name: quantityUomId
parameter.description: The unit the quantities were entered in.

parameter.name: locationSeqId
parameter.description: The receiver's destination, within the receipt step.

parameter.description: resultCode RECEIVED, shipmentId, facilityId, productId, packProductId, quantityAccepted and quantityRejected (stock unit), the entered quantities, unit and factor, receiptSteps, locationSeqId, statusId, lotNumber, serialNumbers, assetIds, assetReceiptIds, remainingQuantity, warnings, and the operation fields.

It needs the explicit confirmation (CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED) and never stands in for a short receipt: what did not arrive is closed or backordered with close#ReceiptRemainder. Not receive#EntireShipment, which accepts every unit not yet handled without the receipt steps or the tracking policy (and multiplies a transfer's totals, F37). Refuses a receipt with a lot- or serial-tracked line still to receive (TRACKING_REQUIRED: receive it line by line) and one with nothing left (NOTHING_TO_RECEIVE); and as receive#ShipmentStock. service.description: AdHocReceipt: receive stock with no order or shipment, through mantle.product.AssetServices.receive#Asset, with a reason kept on the receipt (AssetReceipt.itemDescription) and an optional cost: the quantity in the entered unit converted to the stock unit and kept as entered, a lot and expiry, one unique serial per unit of serialized stock, to the operation policy's receipt step (as receive#ShipmentStock), owned by the facility's organization or another of the user's. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires STOCK_RECEIVE; refuses a facility outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an owner outside them (OWNER_UNAVAILABLE), a product that holds no stock (NOT_STOCK), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), no quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), and the tracking and destination refusals of receive#ShipmentStock.

service.description: Finish a short purchase receipt (ReceiveRemaining): only what was received stays on it, and the remainder of each line is either closed, through Purchasing's close of purchase remainders (mantle.order.OrderServices.close#PurchaseRemainders' close, run in this operation under its STOCK_RECEIVE check: cancel#OrderItem with the explicit remainder, the Requirement allocation and the budget commitment released, the order completed when nothing is open), or backordered, this receipt's items lowered to what was received (update#ShipmentItem) and the order part's remainder put on its open receipt (ensure#PurchaseReceipt). Only then is the receipt delivered (deliver#Shipment, whose ShipmentIncomingDeliveredCreateInvoices SECA bills the accepted quantity of a self-billing supplier as Accounting conditioned it), unless the close cancelled a receipt that received nothing. A remainder sends the receipt exception notice. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires STOCK_RECEIVE; refuses a receipt outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), not a purchase receipt (RECEIPT_TYPE) or no longer open (RECEIPT_CLOSED), a choice other than close or backorder (CHOICE_INVALID) and a missing reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: choice
parameter.description: close or backorder.

parameter.name: reason
parameter.description: Required: checked by the service (REASON_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode CLOSED or BACKORDERED, shipmentId, choice, reason, lines (productId, expected, received, remaining), orders (close: orderId, closedItems, orderStatusId, releasedCommitments), backorders (backorder: orderId, orderPartSeqId, shipmentId), delivered, shipmentStatusId.

return.message: CHOICE_INVALID: Choose to close the remainder or to backorder it
REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason the receipt is short

set.from: lines.map(row => ({productId: row.productId, expected: receiving.text(row.expected), received: receiving.text(row.received), remaining: receiving.text(row.remaining)}))

if.script: receiving.notifyException(recv, choice == 'close' ? 'CLOSED' : 'BACKORDERED', {reason: reason.trim(), lines: lineRows.filter(row => row.remaining != '0')})

set.from: posting.complete(begun.op, recv.facility.ownerPartyId, 'mantle.shipment.Shipment', shipmentId, {resultCode: choice == 'close' ? 'CLOSED' : 'BACKORDERED', shipmentId: shipmentId, choice: choice, reason: reason.trim(), lines: lineRows, orders: orders, backorders: backorders, delivered: delivered, shipmentStatusId: final.statusId})
